title: Coffee Shop dreamin'
content: I visited a coffee shop that dream me is apparently quite familiar with, last night. Ordered my usual matcha latte, say down, and got to casually chatting with the owner and a few customers about some of her craziest encounters. We were laughing about one guy who came in while I was there, last, with a laundry list of a drink, and started throwing a tantrum about it not being done right then and there. The owner, a pretty blonde lady with a hot pink streak in her hair, said, "Yeah, he was all, "I'm gonna take my business elsewhere! Gonna go to the bakery up the street, where there ain't no stupid, lazy, lesbians! They always get my order done quick..." I was like, "Dude, they probably serve you as quickly as possible to get rid of you, but whatever. Have a day as pleasant as you are."" We laughed and I chimed in with, "No, no, you don't understand, she left out the best part! That bakery is owned by her wife! The two shops are part of the same chain!" We were in tears, laughing. Later on, I was invited to walk with the couple of customers I'd been chatting with, and they asked me how I knew the owner. I explained that I had just wandered into the shop when it was still a tiny, one woman operation, before she got married. "Yep, they were just this itsy, bitsy, single flavor note, small batch coffee place. I think she and her wife met because she was trying to learn how to town her own beans. Her wife is a plant whisperer, I swear..." The city was beautiful, quiet and calm with tree lined streets and cobblestone sidewalks and quaint little shop fronts. It was cold, but not unpleasant thanks to the clear sunlight, and the sky was so blue and intense, you felt like you could reach out to touch it. I've never been to that part of my city in any other dreams I can recall. But this one was so nice... I hope to go visit that coffee shop again, soon.
